answer: In the Ember Cartographer network each agent stakes a unique cryptographic token tied to a physical‑world anchor, such as a registered orchard plot, which is recorded on the ledger as immutable proof of identity. When a new agent is vouched for, three existing agents must each attach a timber‑backed endorsement, forming a web‑of‑trust that can be audited for consistency; if any vouchee is later flagged as a Sybil, all endorsements linked to it lose their standing and the associated stakes are slashed.
